items.title: Albert Morgan Interview, 1958-08-19
items.q: You're about the first one that's mentioned him since Bunk Johnson.

ctx.x: Yes, Buddy Johnson. That's right. Yes, that's right.
He died a long time ago. Nobody I've ever talked to knew anything about him. You're about the first one that's mentioned him since Bunk Johnson.
Is that so? Yes. Oh, wonderful trombone player.
